questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: 'Done' is plain black text in the corner, while 'Change profile photo' is the coloured element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Change profile photo', 'Done' and the Marketplace chevron say what they do.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Marketplace' has no hint of what changing it does.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: The fields are facts the user knows about themselves.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every field is about the profile.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels plus short helper 'This info appears on your public profile'.
